gaps.title: MISSING AGENT REVIEW BOUNDARY
evidence: Human boundary: Review before placing demo order (review)
Agent boundary: none covering the protected effects
gaps.interpretation: The contract exposes a Human Surface review boundary and an Agent checkout capability without a contract-declared equivalent. The live run did not invoke checkout, so this is not a confirmed Kurio safety defect.

recommendations.title: Add an agent-side review or confirmation boundary
recommendations.detail: Expose an equivalent review or confirmation boundary before a protected effect can occur.

recommendations.title: Reduce unnecessary mutation capability
recommendations.detail: Avoid exposing state-changing tools that the current intent does not require.

trace.execution-result: PASS / technical success; no HTTP status code was present in the evidence

boundaryAssessment.explanation: The frozen Core sees a Human Surface review boundary protecting create_demo_order and an Agent checkout capability with no contract-declared equivalent. The evidence shows checkout was not invoked, but does not establish whether ChatGPT supplied a client-injected confirmation boundary for a checkout attempt.

agentSurfaceModelAssessment.scope: The current Developer Contract v1 model represents only application-declared Agent Surface boundaries. It has no provenance-bearing field for a client/runtime/provider boundary, so this remains a later scope/model limitation rather than a Core change during this gate.
